footnote_text: On November 12, 2026, the issuer granted to the reporting person a restricted stock award of 72,780 shares under the issuer's Amended and Restated 2019 Stock Incentive Plan, representing the reporting person's annual Board awards for fiscal years 2027 and 2028. Of these shares, 36,390 vest in twelve substantially equal quarterly installments beginning April 1, 2027, and 36,390 vest in twelve substantially equal quarterly installments beginning April 1, 2028, in each case subject to the reporting person's continued service. No annual Board award will be granted to the reporting person for fiscal year 2028.

On November 12, 2026, the issuer granted to the reporting person a restricted stock award of 1,050 shares under the issuer's Amended and Restated 2019 Stock Incentive Plan, representing the reporting person's fiscal year 2027 committee awards, which vest in four substantially equal quarterly installments beginning April 1, 2027, subject to the reporting person's continued service.
